course.name: Algorithms
course.dept: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, BRAC University

lectures.topics: Course goals, schedule, prerequisites, textbooks, assessment; what an algorithm and a computational problem are; what makes an algorithm good
Input size, running time and memory, order of growth, best, worst and average case, upper bounds, the RAM model
Linear, binary and ternary search, iterative and recursive; off-by-one errors and duplicates; finding a peak
Comparison sorting; bubble, insertion and selection sort with best- and worst-case analysis
Divide and conquer, merge sort, quicksort and pivot choice, stable and in-place sorting, the comparison-sorting lower bound
Sorting faster than n log n without comparisons; counting sort and radix sort

simulators.title: Linear Search
simulators.desc: Checking each element from left to right; best, worst and not-present cases.

simulators.title: Binary Search
simulators.desc: Halving the range [lo, hi] on every comparison; leftmost match with duplicates, and a buggy lo = mid version.

simulators.title: Ternary Search
simulators.desc: Two cuts m1 and m2 splitting a sorted array's range in three.

simulators.title: Bubble Sort
simulators.desc: Swapping out-of-order neighbors, pass by pass, until the largest remaining element bubbles to the end.

simulators.title: Insertion Sort
simulators.desc: Lifting out each key and shifting larger elements right to insert it into the sorted part.

simulators.title: Selection Sort
simulators.desc: Scanning for the smallest remaining element and swapping it into the next position.

simulators.title: Merge Sort
simulators.desc: The array splitting down, then merging back up.

simulators.title: Quicksort
simulators.desc: Each pivot partitioning its block; last-element and median-of-three pivots.

simulators.title: Counting Sort
simulators.desc: Counting keys into C, adding the counts up and placing each key into B; placing right to left keeps it stable.

simulators.title: Radix Sort
simulators.desc: One stable counting sort per digit, from the ones digit up, and what goes wrong when a pass is not stable.

assignments.title: Assignment 1
assignments.subtitle: Distributed Merge Sort with a Round-Robin Thread Pool
